title: Grusch asks Brent to help bring John Harrington forward

tellings.quote: No, I was just going to say I mean this is part of what Dave Gush was asking is like could you help make this happen?

plain: In the 2020s, David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who told Congress about hidden UFO programmes, asked the Hollywood screenwriter Brent Friedman to help get John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, to come forward. Friedman tells this himself on the podcast: Grusch was asking, "could you help make this happen?" It matters because Friedman says Herrington once told him things about aliens, so a public statement from a former cabinet member would carry weight.
